findings.passage: “We all know what this is about,” Sen. Lucas said. “But I will not go home and tell people I took away their right to vote. Because that’s what this is.”
findings.note: Quoted by the AJC (column by Patricia Murphy) from his Senate floor remarks against SB 67, which would require an ID number or ID copy to request an absentee ballot. Column is dated 2021-02-24; remarks were the day before.

findings.passage: “It’s amazing. I did not think I had to come to the well after 45 years of being in this body,” Lucas said. “But I want to tell you, we are going to fight.”
findings.note: Quoted by the AJC from his Senate floor remarks on SB 67 (ID for absentee ballot requests).

findings.passage: “I’m going to tell you, we’re going to fight,” Lucas said. “There’s no question what’s going to happen. And you’re going to spend taxpayer money trying to defend it.”
findings.note: Quoted by Capitol Beat from his Senate floor remarks against the absentee voter ID bill (SB 67); he warned of court challenges. Archive page, article date approximate to the Senate vote.
